{{Quote|The Iron Squadron. That was my brother's detachment. He was killed on Mykapo, and I feared his son, Mart Mattin, was dead too.|Jun Sato|<ref name="Iron Squadron" />}}
'''Sato''',<ref name="Wynkahthu Job RR" /> or '''Mart's father''',<ref name="Recon1">{{RebelsRecon|mlpvQhH58X4|#3.07: Inside "Iron Squadron" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-iron-squadron}}</ref> was the [[Parent|father]] of [[Mart Mattin]], and the brother of [[Jun Sato]], a [[commander]] in the growing rebellion against the [[Galactic Empire]]. Mattin's father was a member of [[Iron Squadron]], a [[squadron]] of [[pilot]]s which opposed the tyranny of the Empire. His fighting days came to an end, however, when he was [[Death|killed]]<ref name="Iron Squadron" /> during [[Uprisings on Mykapo]] on [[Mykapo]].<ref name="Dawn of Rebellion" /> He was [[Marriage|married]] to [[Mattin]] with whom he had Mart Mattin.<ref name="A Youth Unpromising">{{RebelsMagCite|35|A Youth Unpromising}}</ref>
